## Review notes

- [ ] The declaration is complete and the evidence-bound SHA matches this PR's current head.
- [ ] Every changed path is within the declared class scope.
- [ ] I have identified relevant tests and their actual results; I have not represented unrun checks as passing.
- [ ] I have disclosed generated/copied material and known limitations.

> The evidence gate is a process classifier, not a conformance certificate. Normative, security-sensitive, ambiguous, or governance-control-plane changes require stronger review and cannot use the reduced path. A label or green check does not replace human review, required CI, or repository policy.
